headline: Proposed cannabis regulations, applications from DMS Trinity and Benevolent Botanicals, and Social Equity model regulations.
summary: Proposed regulations distributed in September come up for discussion and approval. Updates on applications from DMS Trinity and Benevolent Botanicals and talks on adopting Social Equity model regulations are also on the list.

Update on applications and process for DMS Trinity and Benevolent Botanicals
